label: AF3 code + OpenFold3 openbind weights
notes: Test arm. Identical to af3_native.json except for model_dir + of3_weights.
model_dir is INSIDE the image: this .sif ships the converted OpenFold3 openbind
parameters at /models (of3_ported_weights.bin.zst, 1.3 G) next to a one-line
`of3_variant` marker reading 'openbind'. run_alphafold.py reads that marker, so
bare --of3_weights is enough and no --of3_openbind flag is needed. Nothing has to
be bind-mounted for the weights, which is why the image is 5.4 G rather than 4 G.
Everything else — recycles, diffusion samples, seed, MSAs, templates, GPU — is
